name: CopperKeep | Now Open
description:
Welcome to CopperKeep SMP, a survival server built around farming, building, and a community that sticks together. We are a laid-back, no grief, economy SMP where players come first. Everyone is welcome, and both Java and Bedrock players are free to join!

The server runs a set of plugins that improve the experience while staying true to Minecraft's roots, such as player warp shops, grief prevention, an active economy, and more!

Show your support by voting to earn rewards, or visit the store to unlock ranks with perks like extra homes, custom prefixes, bigger shops, and more!

Pull up a chair, start your farm, and stay for a while!

Java IP: play.copperkeep.org

Bedrock IP: play.copperkeep.org Port: 19132

Discord: https://discord.gg/3khSjhDxKK
